title: Who uses which shared package and tool
caption: Runtime packages ship inside the backends' releases; @velexis/testing, the Amadeus stub and tools/e2e are dev-only. Edges are imports (counted with grep over each app's src/ and test/ at a68a8cd8) or commands.

nodes.label: Platform API + worker
nodes.detail: Imports config, logger, crypto, db, errors, api-types at run time; @velexis/testing in its tests.

nodes.label: OTA API + worker
nodes.detail: The heaviest user: `tenantTx` (178 files import @velexis/db), envelope encryption of tenant columns, provisioning through `migrateTenantSchema`.

nodes.label: Portal
nodes.detail: config, logger, errors (code → message), api-types (platform types).

nodes.label: Platform admin
nodes.detail: Same as the portal.

nodes.label: OTA admin
nodes.detail: config, logger, errors; talks to the OTA API through the SDK.

nodes.label: Storefront
nodes.detail: Types only (through the SDK).

nodes.label: JS SDK
nodes.detail: JSDoc types from @velexis/api-types only; no runtime import.

nodes.label: @velexis/config
nodes.detail: `defineConfig`, `env.*`, `readKeyFile`, `loadDevEnvFiles`. The only code that reads `process.env`.

nodes.label: @velexis/logger
nodes.detail: pino, `REDACT_PATHS`, `pinoHttpOptions`, `redactPayload`, `maskPan`, `holdsCardNumber`.

nodes.label: @velexis/crypto
nodes.detail: Envelope encryption, KEK files, `rewrapBatch`, tokens, API-key HMAC, signed URLs, `newId`.

nodes.label: @velexis/db
nodes.detail: Pools, `platformDb`, `tenantTx`, migration runner + `migrate.js`, storage adapter, generated table types.

nodes.label: @velexis/errors
nodes.detail: Generated error catalogue (74 OTA + 29 platform-only codes), `AppError`, `toErrorEnvelope`.

nodes.label: @velexis/api-types
nodes.detail: OpenAPI types (OTA 136 operations, platform 144), operations index, job envelope, queue names, validators, fixtures.

nodes.label: @velexis/testing
nodes.detail: Template test databases, `useRedis`, `FakeClock`, builders, `expectResponseToMatch`, Mailpit, Amadeus and Stripe helpers.

nodes.label: @velexis/amadeus-stub (port 4900)
nodes.detail: Amadeus OAuth + 12 operations, validated against `docs/amadeus-api/`, scenarios by header.

nodes.label: @velexis/reference-data
nodes.detail: Vendored CSV snapshot + loader `dist/cli/load.js` (also shipped to the VM).

nodes.label: @velexis/e2e (Playwright)
nodes.detail: Starts the built stack on a fresh database and drives every UI.

nodes.label: tools/ci, tools/plan-lint
nodes.detail: Plain-Node checks run by `ci.yml`.

nodes.label: tools/perf, tools/dev
nodes.detail: Platform performance smoke test, GC observer, unit heap flags; `dev:keys` and `stripe-listen.sh`.

nodes.label: velexis-deploy
nodes.detail: Runs `migrate.js` (platform, reference, tenants) and the reference loader before switching releases.
